Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fly-in R10-FLY-PREPR-SUMMARY (size S), owner order tvofi 2026-10-28 (prompt-cache gap 5): tool outputs stay in a seat's context for every later turn; prepr.sh output alone was 27.6M cached-read tokens over 682 calls in one day. Give tools/pr/prepr.sh a summary-only default on stdout: the step verdict lines (one per step: name, PASS/REFUSE/SKIP), every refusal's reason and its failing lines, and the final result line with rc; the full log goes to a file whose path the last line prints (under the state dir or $TMPDIR with a unique name, never a fixed /tmp name: tmp_paths.py). `PREPR_VERBOSE=1` (or `--verbose`) restores today's full stdout. Every caller that greps prepr's stdout (app_push.sh, update_pr.sh, open_pr.sh, body_push.sh, handoff_push.sh, ci_predict, merge_train, review_packet, self-tests) must still find what it greps: enumerate them with git grep and prove each by running its self-test. Failing test first: a self-test arm asserting stdout carries no per-test chatter yet carries a REFUSE line's reason; mutant: printing the full log to stdout fails it; null control: a refusal is still visible on stdout. Rerun PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 tools/pr/prepr.sh. Minimal diff.
